rundown: 76ers beat Bucks 132-129 at Xfinity Mobile Arena in Philadelphia, PA in front of 21,043. 76ers led 60-59 at the half and held on.
Leading the way — Bucks: Tyler Herro 50 pts, 7 ast, 11 reb. 76ers: Joel Embiid 26 pts, 9 ast, 17 reb.
Where 76ers won it: they shot 51% to 48%, had 33 assists to 25 and turned it over 4 times to 8.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): 76ers closed as 11.5-point favorites and won but didn't cover (Bucks +11.5 cashed); the total closed at 231.5 and they combined for 261, over by 29.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 21, 12:55 PM ET. It had Bucks 14% and 76ers 86%, projecting Bucks 108.6 – 76ers 121.5 (230 total, 76ers by 12.9).

Final: Bucks 129 – 76ers 132. Right winner: it had 76ers at 86%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Bucks came in with a 3% below average attack and a 4% leakier than average defense (1-15, 108.1 scored and 121.1 allowed a game over 16 games), worth about 98 and 99 games of evidence. Projected to score 108.6, they scored 129 (+20.4 points, 19% over); projected to allow 121.5, they allowed 132 (+10.5 points, 9% over).

76ers came in with a league-average attack and a league-average defense (13-3, 114.5 scored and 111.6 allowed a game over 16 games), worth about 92 and 93 games of evidence. Projected to score 121.5, they scored 132 (+10.5 points, 9% over); projected to allow 108.6, they allowed 129 (+20.4 points, 19% over).

The bigger miss was Bucks' scoring (+20.4 points against projection); both sides outscored their projections, so the game ran hotter than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 261 against 230 projected (+31), about the 96th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±18.2).

Margin: 76ers by 3 against 76ers by 12.9 projected, about the 21st percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
PHI ML (-620) at -620: the algo gave it 83% vs 83% fair (+0.3 pts) — won (+0.2u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 83%). MIL ML (+455) at +455: the algo gave it 17% vs 17% fair (-0.3 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 17%). PHI -11.5 (-106) at -106: the algo gave it 50% vs 49% fair (+0.5 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. MIL +11.5 (-114) at -114: the algo gave it 50% vs 51% fair (-0.5 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. OVER 231.5 (-105) at -105: the algo gave it 49% vs 49% fair (-0.2 pts) — won (+1u); same number as the close. UNDER 231.5 (-115) at -115: the algo gave it 51% vs 51% fair (+0.2 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body: Splits (Action Network): spread: 38% of bets on Bucks, 48% of the money — Bucks covered; total: 64% of bets on the over, 72% of the money — it went over; moneyline: 4% of bets on Bucks, 13% of the money.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.128 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -10.1 points. It counts toward NBA scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 129 graded NBA games the algo now scales scoring ×0.995 and gives home teams -0.2 points. Team corrections so far: Bucks attack ×0.993, defense ×1.002 (10 games); 76ers attack ×1.022, defense ×1.030 (9 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total outside its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
